title: Chinese Pancake Potatoes
description: A Chinese-inspired dish featuring a crispy pancake and pan-fried potatoes. A delicious and savory snack.
instructions: In a large bowl, combine flour, water, and salt. Mix until a dough forms.
Knead the dough for 2-3 minutes until smooth.
Divide the dough into 4 equal pieces.
Roll out each piece into a thin circle, about 6 inches in diameter.
Heat a non-stick pan or wok over medium heat.
Brush the pancake with a small amount of vegetable oil.
Pan-fry the pancake until crispy and golden brown, about 2-3 minutes per side.
While the pancake is cooking, slice the potatoes into thin rounds.
Heat the same pan or wok over high heat.
Add the sliced potatoes and cook until crispy and golden brown, about 3-4 minutes per side.
Garnish with sliced green onions and ginger.
Serve the potatoes with the crispy pancake.
